headline: Data Engineering Lead at Brightwind Grid | Streaming pipelines for renewable energy
summary: I build the data pipelines that tell a wind farm operator, every few seconds, how much power the grid can take. Before energy I worked on payments data in Lagos. I care about simple, well-tested pipelines and about bringing more women into data engineering.

experiences.title: Data Engineering Lead
experiences.description: Leads a team of six engineers. Moved turbine telemetry from nightly batch jobs to a streaming pipeline that updates grid forecasts every 10 seconds, which cut curtailment losses by about 8%.

experiences.title: Senior Data Engineer
experiences.description: Built the fraud-detection data platform for card payments across four countries. Started the company's internal data engineering guild.

education.description: Part-time while working. Thesis on forecasting wind power with gradient-boosted trees.

volunteer_work.description: Mentors career switchers moving into data engineering, four mentees a year.

projects.title: gridflow (open source)
projects.description: Maintainer of a small Python library that cleans and resamples turbine sensor data. Used by three energy start-ups.
